summary: Transform your approach to climate change advocacy with our expert-led training. Gain essential skills to communicate effectively and inspire meaningful action
lede: Climate change communication and advocacy helps professionals turn climate evidence into clear messages and structured policy engagement. Designed for people working in climate, sustainability, policy, advocacy or communications, it develops practical skills in audience analysis and message framing, advocacy briefs and campaign planning, and stakeholder mapping and campaign monitoring.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who already work with climate, sustainability, policy, advocacy, or communications content and need to make their work more persuasive, structured, and measurable.
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, access to a spreadsheet tool, and a current climate communication or advocacy issue from your work. Participants should be ready to review sample policy briefs, stakeholder maps, and campaign materials during the course.
